summary: Steep cul-de-sac kerb with homes 11-15 m away on the same side.

best_section.where: East kerb of Gilia Court cul-de-sac, where residents park

drivers.seclusion: Houses and gardens sit 11-20 m from the kerb on this side, with a tennis court behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with several cars parked at the kerb, but it falls about 13% along the whole section.
drivers.convention: Residents' cars line the kerb, so a van would be beside homes; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep: about 13% grade, over the 12% limit
Dwellings 11-15 m away on same side
Witton Creek 24 m away; ground is 38-44 m, not low-lying
sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees on the east side give some morning shade.
